title: Send a personal email now
summary: Send a caller-provided subject and plain-text body immediately to the fixed personal recipient through Resend.
use_when: The user explicitly asks to send an email now to their fixed personal inbox and supplies or approves the subject and body.
A previously drafted message should now be sent exactly as approved.
do_not_use_when: The user asks only to draft, revise, preview, or discuss an email.
The intended recipient is anyone other than the fixed personal inbox.
The request needs HTML, attachments, carbon copies, scheduling, or delivery tracking.
outcome: Resend accepts one immediate plain-text email submission containing the caller-provided subject and body for the fixed recipient.
effects: Reads `RESEND_API_KEY` from the process environment and makes an authenticated network request to Resend.
Discloses the supplied subject and body to Resend and the fixed recipient's Gmail provider.
Uses product-fixed sender and recipient addresses; callers cannot override either address.
authority: Email owns the fixed addresses, request construction, and command result.
Resend owns submission acceptance and its message record; Gmail owns final delivery and inbox receipt.
success: The command exits successfully and reports the Resend message identifier returned for the accepted submission.
When final receipt matters, the intended message is observed separately in the Gmail inbox.
failure_and_recovery: An input, authentication, transport, or Resend rejection exits unsuccessfully and reports a secret-safe error.
One invocation retries transport errors, rate limits, and server errors at most twice with the same frozen request and idempotency key.
Email has no delivery queue or retained message state; resolve the reported cause and issue a new explicit send request if retry is intended.
After ambiguous transport failure, inspect Resend before retrying when avoiding a duplicate matters.
privacy: The exact subject and body leave the machine for Resend and Gmail when the command sends.
Email does not retain the subject, body, API key, or a delivery history in local product state.
The installed wrapper sources `~/.zshrc`, extracts only `RESEND_API_KEY`, and scrubs unrelated caller environment variables before starting the payload.
does_not_authorize: Sending when the user requested only a draft, preview, revision, or explanation.
Changing the fixed sender, recipient, Resend account, or API key.
Treating Resend acceptance as proof of final Gmail delivery.
